title: Hydrocarbon Mixtures - Average Boiling Points vs. Gravity and Molecular Weights
description: Calculate average boiling point (ABP) of hydrocarbon mixtures based on molecular weight and specific gravity using Riazi-Daubert correlations. Two equations are provided: one for molecular weights 70-300 and another for 300-700.

components.content: Average Boiling Point Calculator using Riazi-Daubert Correlations

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 1) - Kelvin
outputs.formula: 3.76587 * EXP(3.7741E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight + 2.98404 * inputs.specific_gravity - 4.25288E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.40167) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -1.58262)

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 2) - Kelvin
outputs.formula: 9.3369 * EXP(1.6514E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight + 1.4103 * inputs.specific_gravity - 7.5152E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.5369) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -0.7276)

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 1) - Celsius
outputs.formula: 3.76587 * EXP(3.7741E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight + 2.98404 * inputs.specific_gravity - 4.25288E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.40167) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -1.58262) - 273.15

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 2) - Celsius
outputs.formula: 9.3369 * EXP(1.6514E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight + 1.4103 * inputs.specific_gravity - 7.5152E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.5369) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -0.7276) - 273.15

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 1) - Fahrenheit
outputs.formula: (3.76587 * EXP(3.7741E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight + 2.98404 * inputs.specific_gravity - 4.25288E-03 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.40167) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -1.58262) - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32

outputs.label: ABP (Equation 2) - Fahrenheit
outputs.formula: (9.3369 * EXP(1.6514E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight + 1.4103 * inputs.specific_gravity - 7.5152E-04 * inputs.molecular_weight * inputs.specific_gravity) * POW(inputs.molecular_weight, 0.5369) * POW(inputs.specific_gravity, -0.7276) - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32
